metadata.title: ÉLOGE DE M. LE BARON GEORGES CUVIER

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The text exhibits the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and flat, unbracketed serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Didot or Bodoni), which was the standard for official French printing in the early 19th century.
